name: Linear
summary: Issue tracking for product and engineering teams.

flows.title: Create an issue
steps: Press C, or click the create issue icon, to open the new issue window. Opening https://linear.new in the browser does the same.
Give the issue a title and a status. Both are required; every other field is optional.

flows.title: Find an issue
steps: Press / to open Search, and type to find issues, projects and documents.
To search issues only, by title or identifier, press O then I.
To search the titles in the view already open, press Cmd/Ctrl + F.

flows.title: Assign an issue
steps: Open the issue, or hover over it in a list or board.
Press A to open the assignment menu, or set the assignee in the issue's properties sidebar.
Pick the person. Press I instead to assign it to yourself, and pick No assignee to remove one.
